b13272663c0b5c36.description: About the Role TXM Solutions is seeking an experienced Interiors & FF&E Specialist to join our team in Abha, 'Asir, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing interior design, finishes, and Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment (FF&E) for luxury hospitality projects, including five-star hotels, resorts, and high-end mixed-use developments. The specialist will ensure all submissions and installations comply with approved design specifications, international brand standards, and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Review interior design drawings, specifications, material schedules, shop drawings, and technical submissions. Ensure interior design and fit-out works comply with approved project specifications, hotel operator standards, and brand requirements. Evaluate specialist finishes, architectural details, joinery, and interior construction systems. Identify design discrepancies, coordination issues, and potential construction risks, providing technical recommendations. Review FF&E specifications, material submissions, samples, and installation requirements, ensuring coordination with architectural finishes, MEP systems, and lighting. Participate in the review and approval of interior finishes, material samples, and mock-ups, inspecting guest rooms, suites, villas, and public-area mock-ups for compliance. Conduct regular site inspections of interior fit-out works, specialist finishes, joinery, and FF&E installations to verify compliance and quality. Coordinate with architects, interior designers, contractors, consultants, hotel operators, and multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout project stages. Lead and participate in snagging inspections for various areas, preparing detailed reports and monitoring corrective actions. Verify completion of outstanding interior and FF&E works and review close-out documentation, warranties, and handover submissions. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience, with at least 12 years specifically in luxury hospitality, five-star hotels, resorts, and high-end mixed-use developments. Demonstrated technical expertise in luxury hotel interiors, specialist finishes, FF&E coordination, mock-up approvals, quality inspections, and project close-out. Experience ensuring compliance with approved design specifications, hotel operator requirements, international brand standards, and applicable regulations. Skills and Competencies Strong technical knowledge of interior design, fit-out works, and FF&E. Ability to identify design discrepancies, coordination issues, and construction risks. Proficiency in reviewing technical drawings, specifications, and material submissions. Effective coordination and communication skills with diverse project stakeholders. Attention to detail in quality assurance, site inspections, and snagging processes. Work Environment This role requires close coordination with various teams, including architects, interior designers, contractors, consultants, hotel operators, and multidisciplinary engineering teams. The position is based in Abha, 'Asir, Saudi Arabia, and is a full-time engagement. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are invited to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

b16c26fd8c90ad2d.description: About PepsiCo PepsiCo products are consumed over one billion times daily across more than 200 countries and territories. In 2021, PepsiCo generated over $79 billion in net revenue, driven by a portfolio of beverages and convenient foods including LAY’S ®️, DORITOS ®️, CHEETOS ®️, GATORADE ®️, PEPSI ®️, and QUAKER ®️. The company's vision is to be the Global Leader in Beverages and Convenient Foods by Winning with PepsiCo Positive (pep+), a strategic transformation focused on sustainability and human capital. Role Overview As a Salesman at PepsiCo, you will be an integral part of the sales team, responsible for maximizing sales volume, minimizing product waste, and achieving distribution targets. This full-time role involves implementing merchandising standards, collecting accounts receivable, and maintaining high levels of customer service. Adherence to operating procedures is essential to ensure consistent standards across KSA. Key Responsibilities Sell the full range of products to an agreed list of customers, measured against established sales targets. Ensure product stales remain below the target provided by the supervisor. Provide approved customer service, maintaining call frequency and daily route plans to meet company satisfaction standards. Conduct daily and weekly vehicle checks as per operating procedures, ensuring the sales vehicle is clean and roadworthy, and reporting any defects or damage promptly. Agree daily order requirements for the subsequent selling period. Maintain individual customer stock levels to agreed requirements to minimize out-of-stock situations. Implement agreed in-store merchandising communicated by the supervisor, coordinating with company merchandisers where applicable. Advise the supervisor of relevant competitor activity in the assigned area during daily debriefings. Perform daily reconciliation of all cheques, cash, and credit sales, ensuring zero stock and cash shortages. Maintain a neat and presentable appearance at all times. Adhere to high driving standards and obey all driving regulations. Performance Measurement Performance in this role will be measured against specific Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Consistent failure to meet these targets may result in disciplinary action. Daily/weekly sales versus planned sales. Daily positive calls versus plan. Daily call sequence versus plan. Stales versus target. Zero cash and stock shortages. Professional Development The Salesman will be required to attend training courses designed to enhance professionalism and customer service skills. Daily debriefing sessions with the supervisor are also a mandatory part of the role to review performance and market information. Work Environment This role operates within a dynamic and collaborative team environment. PepsiCo is committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive space where all employees are valued and have a voice.

The company is seeking an experienced professional to join its Master Development Unit in Riyadh Province, specifically in Riyadh, for a full-time role. This position informs land cost allocation outcomes and masterplanning decisions as districts progress through planning, design, and delivery phases. The role requires advanced financial modeling capabilities and strong project management skills, balancing analytical depth with cross-functional collaboration. Key Responsibilities Manage detailed city-wide and district-level land cost modeling and allocation. Review data accuracy for all related analyses. Conduct subsidy scenario modeling and sensitivity analysis across multiple development pathways. Translate complex data into concise summaries to support decision-making. Support the development and enhancement of the land cost model structure. Contribute to land valuation and financial analysis to support strategic decision-making. Support multidisciplinary coordination across Implementation, Cost Planning, and Master Planning teams, among others. Contribute to land sale strategy, land transactions, and commercial deals. Challenge assumptions and provide recommendations to improve investment outcomes. Support executive-level reporting and presentations. Required Skills and Experience 8-12 years of relevant experience. Advanced financial modeling capability. Strong project management skills. Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional workstreams. Understanding of how land is planned, subdivided, serviced, and monetized. Knowledge of how decisions influence land value, infrastructure cost, and financing outcomes. Ability to bridge technical and commercial disciplines to support decision-making. Collaboration and Impact This role involves daily collaboration with workstreams across Implementation, Cost Planning, Master Planning, the wider MDU Financing team, and other business units. The Senior Manager will be responsible for translating complex data into concise business insights to support masterplanning outcomes and strategic decisions.

b1076f1839979cda.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة تودو أوبس عن فرصة تدريبية بدوام كامل لحديثي التخرج في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية، لشغل وظيفة محلل نظم المعلومات. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تطوير المهارات العملية في تحليل نظم المعلومات من خلال التدريب على تحليل متطلبات العملاء وإجراءات العمل، والمشاركة في تهيئة نظام Odoo واختباره وتوثيقه ودعم المستخدمين، وذلك تحت إشراف فريق التنفيذ. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية التدرب على جمع المتطلبات وتوثيق إجراءات العمل بشكل منهجي. المشاركة في تجهيز البيانات الأساسية وتهيئة وظائف نظام Odoo، تحت إشراف مباشر من الفريق المختص. تنفيذ سيناريوهات اختبار بسيطة وتسجيل النتائج والملاحظات بدقة. المساعدة في إعداد أدلة الاستخدام وتقديم الدعم الفني للمستخدمين. تنفيذ المهام التدريبية المحددة وتوثيق ما تم تعلمه ومراجعته مع المشرف المباشر. المؤهلات والخبرات هذه الفرصة مخصصة لحديثي التخرج، وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. القدرة على التعلم السريع والتكيف مع بيئات العمل التقنية. بيئة العمل يعمل محلل نظم المعلومات ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة تودو أوبس بالدمام. يتطلب الدور العمل بدوام كامل في بيئة داعمة تهدف إلى تطوير الكفاءات التقنية والعملية لحديثي التخرج. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن. التقديم ندعو المهتمين من حديثي التخرج للتقدم لهذه الفرصة لتطوير مسيرتهم المهنية في مجال تحليل نظم المعلومات.

b13c7a02988d5aa6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة خالد عبيد درويش الرشيدي للنقليات عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور إلى بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء وإدارة دورة المبيعات بالكامل، من جمع البيانات وتقديم العروض إلى إتمام البيع وتحصيل الديون. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات (السلع والخدمات) لتقديم عروض بيع دقيقة ومنافسة. إعداد وتحديث قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء وزيارتهم لترويج المنتجات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المخولة، وإتمام عملية البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة تحصيل ديون العملاء، وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، وتوريدها للدائرة المالية بشكل منتظم. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها لضمان الشفافية وتتبع الأداء. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء وإدارة عملية البيع بفعالية. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتحليل البيانات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب العمل الميداني والتواصل المباشر مع العملاء. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في مؤسسة خالد عبيد درويش الرشيدي للنقليات.

b1528bc68b374e4c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مراق للتجارة عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على بيع مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، وتوفير معلومات دقيقة عن المنتجات، وإدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء. توفير معلومات شاملة للعملاء حول المنتجات، بما في ذلك استخداماتها وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام لضمان توفر المنتجات والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات الجديدة والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة. إدارة عمليات الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بكفاءة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً للسياسات المتبعة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم معلومات واضحة ودقيقة عن المنتجات. مهارات جيدة في إدارة المخزون وتنظيم المتجر. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل البائع ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي لدعم أهداف الشركة التجارية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

This full-time role is responsible for the comprehensive management and development of assigned product categories to achieve specific sales, margin, and growth targets. The position involves strategic planning, supplier relations, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure optimal category performance. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute category strategies that align with overall business objectives. Manage product assortment, pricing strategies, promotional activities, and the product lifecycle. Analyze sales data, margin performance, market trends, and customer behavior to drive category performance. Identify growth opportunities, new product introductions, and category expansion initiatives. Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, and contracts with suppliers and vendors. Build and maintain strong professional relationships with key suppliers. Collaborate closely with marketing, supply chain, finance, and operations teams. Stock availability and inventory turnover rates. Supplier performance evaluations. Effectiveness of promotional campaigns. Market share growth within assigned categories. b105c630cd64fc70.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة يبحث فندق سرايا طابه عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقه في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على توفير تجربة استقبال ممتازة للزوار والعملاء، وإدارة الاتصالات الهاتفية، وتنظيم السجلات الإدارية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء بترحيب، وتحديد احتياجاتهم، وتقديم المعلومات المطلوبة لهم. إبلاغ الموظفين المعنيين بوصول الزوار والعملاء وتوجيههم إليهم. التعامل مع المكالمات الهاتفية الواردة، والرد على الاستفسارات، أو تحويل المكالمات إلى الأقسام المختصة. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية اللازمة لجمع المعلومات أو التنسيق. ترتيب وتنسيق مواعيد المقابلات والاجتماعات. تسجيل بيانات الزوار والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة لذلك بدقة. الالتزام التام بالسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة والأدلة الإجرائية المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بمهنية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. بيئة العمل تتمثل بيئة العمل في فندق سرايا طابه بالمدينة المنورة، ضمن فريق يسعى لتقديم أفضل خدمة للنزلاء. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الحضور المنتظم في مقر الفندق. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق فندق سرايا طابه في المدينة المنورة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

b1318b8a4b7101d8.job_title: MS Back Office Cloud Infra Engineer
b1318b8a4b7101d8.description: About the Role Ericsson KSA is seeking an MS Back Office Cloud Infra Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves managing second-level operations for a large multivendor Telco-Cloud within managed services. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving cloud infrastructure operational targets in line with contractual KPIs and maintaining deliverables quality within SLAs. The position requires 3-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Perform fault management and TT resolution. Manage change requests. Handle incidents and emergencies. Introduce new nodes and services. Manage the lifecycle of nodes/systems through upgrades. Collaborate with internal teams and all vendor TACs to implement changes that meet customer needs. Demonstrated ability to implement new techniques or apply positive changes to existing processes to improve operational efficiency. Ability to manage demanding customer expectations while maintaining high satisfaction levels. b163b0257501492e.description: About Datalake Datalake is a Riyadh-based technology company that builds and operates engineering teams for enterprise and public sector clients across Saudi Arabia. The company places senior engineers on long-term programs and supports them with a delivery platform for onboarding, timesheets, quality, and continuity. Datalake is certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022. Position Overview Datalake is seeking a Cloud and Infrastructure Automation Engineer to manage and automate an Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environment for a government sector client in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves reducing manual tasks, enhancing stability, and maintaining the security, documentation, and cost efficiency of the environment. The engineer will work on-site with the client's IT team and collaborate with Datalake's integration, DevOps, and network specialists. Key Responsibilities Operate OCI services including compute, storage, networking, compartments, and IAM. Automate infrastructure and configuration using Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, and Bash. Manage monitoring, backup, and cost optimization; oversee service accounts, keys, and certificates. Integrate infrastructure with SIEM, EDR, PAM, and ITSM/CMDB tools, and automate network and disaster recovery tasks. Document all aspects of the environment, including runbooks, Terraform modules, IAM and backup records, and cloud configuration. Troubleshoot infrastructure issues and provide support for major incidents. Required Experience and Qualifications 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Proficiency in managing and automating Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments. Experience with automation tools such as Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, and Bash. Knowledge of monitoring, backup, cost optimization, and security best practices. Ability to integrate infrastructure with various IT management and security tools. Work Environment and Additional Requirements This role requires full-time, on-site work in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Relocation assistance will be provided. Adherence to the client's security protocols is mandatory, including restrictions on personal accounts, use of Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), signing Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDA) before access, and prohibiting the use of public AI tools with client data or code. The program is multi-year with a public sector client, offering long-term engagement. Why Datalake Datalake offers real ownership of a production cloud environment from the start. The company's delivery team focuses on measuring output rather than attendance, fostering a results-oriented work culture.

b1c6949efb930002.description: About the Role Delta Hotels and Resorts® is seeking a Supervisor Banquet Operations to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves ensuring cohesive teamwork within the banquet operations, monitoring staff appearance, and effectively communicating with guests and other departments to meet customer needs. The supervisor will also support management with various human resources functions and maintain positive professional relationships. Key Responsibilities Ensure cohesive teamwork among banquet staff. b126ed5187e778b3.description: About SYSTRA SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. b1a63f9db3765ce5.job_title: Senior Product Manager - Catalog and Store
b1a63f9db3765ce5.description: At Salla, we are building the digital backbone of commerce in the region, for thousands of merchants starting, growing and scaling their businesses. Catalog is the layer underneath everything: storefronts, search, recommendations and every channel a merchant sells through read from the same product data. This role owns both sides of that line, the catalog merchants build and the store their buyers shop. Salla does not build the catalog. Merchants do, and often not even the merchant: a freelancer, operations staff, an agency. The buyer never sees the catalog, only whether they can find the product, trust the page and get what they ordered. Your job is to change what people who do not work for you produce, and turn that data into a store that converts. You lead four product managers across Catalog and Store, and you carry the numbers. Areas of impact: product data input, structure and meaning, AI enrichment, store experience and search, and how the data performs downstream. Responsibilities: Set the strategy for Catalog and Store as one system, so a new category or way of selling is a configuration, not a rebuild. Own how product data is created and improved, and define quality by how the data performs downstream, not by how many fields are filled. Own the buyer's path from search to purchase: search relevance, the product page and availability. Design for the people who actually enter the data, including those who do not own the store, so the good path is the fastest one. Put AI to work where it earns trust: decide what we generate, what we suggest and what we never touch, and learn from every correction. Use AI to take merchants from a blank store to a well-designed, ready-to-sell storefront. Validate every bet against the outcome it promised: experiment where traffic allows, measure where it does not, and stop what does not work. Decide how much structure to impose and where merchants stay free, including for external channels with strict requirements. Lead four product managers, two on Catalog and two on Store: give them real ownership, coach their craft and raise the bar of what the group ships. Six or more years in product management, including a self-serve platform where users created their own data and you owned its quality. A number you moved by changing what users produced at the moment of entry, not by cleaning it up afterwards. Hands-on ownership of a buyer-facing commerce experience, such as search, discovery or product pages, with conversion you moved and experiments that proved it. AI in production on structured data, with concrete answers on confidence thresholds, error rates and what you did when it was wrong at scale. Fluency in how product data is structured: taxonomies, attributes, variants, identifiers, matching, and external channel requirements. You own outcomes rather than roadmaps, can set a strategy others repeat, and have managed and coached product managers without stepping away from the craft. Full professional fluency in Arabic and English, regional merchant context preferred, and willing to work on-site in Saudi Arabia.
